name: Cocobay Da Nang
area: Hoa Hai ward, Ngu Hanh Son, Da Nang
docs_listed: no live developer project page: cocobay.vn now carries a generic page plus menus for unrelated projects (Sun Glory, Sun Galaxy, The Fullton); empiregroup.vn has an expired SSL certificate
2016 to 2019 marketing promised a 12% annual guaranteed return for 8 years (press)
May 2024 restart schedule sent by Thanh Do JSC to Da Nang authorities (press), with block completions from Oct 2024 to Jan 2029
note: Condotel and entertainment complex (VND 11,000bn, reported as 31 to 51 ha) by Thanh Do Investment Development and Construction JSC (Empire Group) that stopped paying its 12% guaranteed return to about 1,700 buyers from 2020 and has been stalled since early 2022; a May 2024 restart plan was not carried out and Sept 2025 press describes unfinished, deteriorating blocks while Da Nang recalculates the land price to collect unpaid land charges. The city says the project never received investment policy approval, so buyers cannot yet get title certificates. (checked 1 Nov 2026)

seed.developer_delivered: Part of Cocobay (about 3,000 of a planned 10,000 rooms) opened from 2017, per VnExpress 2019; no other delivered projects stated

evidence.permit: No permit number published by the developer. Press cites a 1:500 plan amendment (Decision 593/QD-UBND, 1 Feb 2019) and an architecture opinion (2328/SXD-QHKT, 2 Apr 2019), but Tuoi Tre reports the city found the project never received investment policy approval
evidence.escrow: Nothing published; returns were paid to buyers' banks under three-way loan agreements, which is not deposit protection
evidence.progress: No developer updates. Independent press: work stopped from early 2022; Sept 2025 site visit found unfinished, rusting blocks and no visible change after the May 2024 restart plan
evidence.record: No track record published; the only delivered work is the partly opened Cocobay itself
evidence.returns: Sold with a 12% per year guaranteed return (8 years, until 2026), which the developer stopped paying from 2020

claims.claim: Buyers guaranteed a 12% annual return for 8 years
Developer stopped paying guaranteed returns to about 1,700 buyers from 2020
Project legally approved (1:500 plan amendment Decision 593/QD-UBND of 1 Feb 2019)
Project has investment policy approval allowing title certificates for buyers
Condotel buyers hold title
Construction restarts from May 2024 with blocks completed between Oct 2024 and Jan 2029
Site work is ongoing
10,000 rooms planned, about 3,000 built (2019)
Developer is Thanh Do Investment Development and Construction JSC (Empire Group)
Developer financially sound (losses since 2017, VND 10.17 trillion of debt obligations as of 2018)
Developer may cancel buyer contracts unilaterally (notices Dec 2019 and 12 Mar 2024)
Official project website still live

facts.developer_company: Thanh Do Investment Development and Construction JSC (Cong ty CP Dau tu Phat trien va Xay dung Thanh Do), Empire Group
facts.rental_programme: Developer-run condotel rental with 12% guaranteed annual return, suspended from 2020
amenities: beachfront location on the Da Nang to Hoi An coastal road
facts.permit_authority: Da Nang People's Committee and Department of Construction

positives: Da Nang listed the project among 15 whose land and legal issues it aims to resolve, targeted for Q1 2026

flags.text: VnExpress reported in Nov 2019 that Empire Group told about 1,700 buyers it would stop paying the 12% guaranteed annual return from 2020, leaving many to service bank loans themselves.
VnExpress reported accumulated losses of VND 134bn and debt obligations of VND 10.17 trillion as of 2018.
Dan Tri reported that on 12 March 2024 Thanh Do JSC notified buyers it was unilaterally terminating sale contracts while restructuring.

Tuoi Tre (via vietnam.vn) reported the Da Nang environment department found the project had not received investment policy approval, so there was no legal basis to issue title certificates to apartment buyers; it is among 15 projects named in Government Inspectorate conclusion 2852/2012 with land charges being recalculated.
VietnamFinance reported in Sept 2025 that the site remained abandoned, with unfinished blocks and rusting structures, despite a restart planned for May 2024.
